gt.notes: Primary admin auth surface; brute-force target.

io_variants.reason: authentication.setup: create the OWNER on a fresh install (UNAUTHENTICATED)
isSetup: whether the blog has been set up

reachability_conditions: POST reachable ONLY before setup completes (fresh install) -- else 403.
gt.notes: Unauthenticated owner-creation; a setup-race / re-setup attack surface.

io_variants.reason: resetPassword: set a new password via emailed token

reachability_conditions: Public; PUT needs a valid emailed token.

io_variants.reason: acceptInvitation: staff accepts an invite and sets a password (UNAUTH)
isInvitation: check an invite exists for an email

reachability_conditions: Public; needs a valid invite token/email.

io_variants.reason: identities.read: mints an SSO identity token for the staff user

semantic_output_decisions.reason: SSO identity token for the authenticated staff user.

reachability_conditions: Authenticated admin; editing another user requires sufficient role.
gt.notes: Cross-user edit/delete is role-gated by authorizeAdminApi -- a privilege-boundary surface.
Owner-only; site takeover primitive if abused.

io_variants.reason: memberSigninUrls.read: mints a magic sign-in URL for a member

semantic_output_decisions.reason: Impersonation URL: logs anyone in AS the member.

io_variants.reason: db.exportContent: dumps ALL content as JSON

gt.notes: GET=full exfiltration; DELETE=destructive wipe; POST=import (mass-assignment surface).
Arbitrary ZIP -> theme files (template/helpers): code-adjacent upload surface.
Server fetches a remote source -> SSRF-adjacent.

io_variants.reason: invites.add: invite a staff user with a role

gt.notes: Inviting a high role is a privilege-escalation surface if role checks are weak.
